description: This file contains unit tests for NATS streaming integration within an Orleans project. It includes setup and teardown logic for NATS streams, configuration of silo and client builders, and multiple test cases covering different producer/consumer scenarios using NATS streams.

classes.name: NatsStreamTests
classes.description: Contains setup, teardown, and test methods for testing NATS streaming within an Orleans environment. Uses Xunit for testing and includes nested configurator classes for silo and client configuration.

classes.name: MySiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans silo builder to add NATS streams and memory storage in the test setup.

classes.name: MyClientBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans client builder to add NATS stream provider.

methods.name: NatsStreamTests
methods.description: Constructor that initializes NATS connection and context, and checks for server availability.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the test cluster with silo and client configurators.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Sets up NATS connection and cleans up existing streams before tests.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Cleans up streams and disposes the NATS connection after tests.
